data.text:
AWARENESS AND SHARING PRAYERS FOR EVERYONE’S SAFETY 

Everyone, please stay alert and keep safe! 

PAGASA has released Impact-Based Warning No. 2 for Tropical Cyclone “UWAN”, which is expected to bring heavy rainfall and possible flooding over Metro Manila from November 9–10, 2025 (Sunday to Monday).

⚠️ Significant impacts are expected, including possible damage to homes and facilities, power interruptions, and travel disruptions. Let’s all prepare early, follow safety reminders, and stay updated through official sources.

💧 Stay indoors during heavy rain.
⚡ Avoid floodwaters and electrical hazards.
🚫 Don’t cross or drive through flooded areas.
🕯 Keep emergency supplies ready.
🙏 Let’s pray for everyone’s safety, especially those in affected areas.

Stay safe, stay informed, and let’s continue to look out for one another. 

#StaySafePH 
#PERAYA #BABII #POLCA

#WalangPasok: Mayor Isko Moreno orders the suspension of all face-to-face classes at all levels, both public and private schools in the City of Manila, on Monday, November 10, due to the expected impact of Typhoon #UwanPH, which may bring heavy rainfall, strong winds, and possible flooding to the city.

All schools were directed to shift to Alternative Delivery Modes of Learning  to ensure the continuity of education while keeping students and personnel safe. | @dMorcosoINQ
